blocks.title: Condensation polymerisation
blocks.text: Condensation polymerisation mein monomers aapas mein jurte hain, lekin har dafa jab naya bond banta hai to monomers se aik chhota molecule nikal jata (eliminate hota) hai.

Yeh chhota molecule aam tor par paani (H₂O) hota hai, lekin HCl, CH₃OH ya NH₃ bhi ho sakta hai. Har monomer mein kam az kam do reactive functional groups (jaise -OH, -COOH, -NH₂) hone chahiye jo aik doosre se react kar sakein. Yeh groups monomer ke mukhtalif siron (ends) par hote hain. Chhota molecule hamesha side product ke tor par banta hai. Yeh amal aam tor par qadam ba qadam (step-by-step) hota hai, jaise Figure 26.3 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Condensation polymerisation: monomers H-X-H aur HO-Y-OH, 'do qism ke monomers'. Yeh H-X-[H+HO]-Y-[OH+H]-X-[H+HO]-Y-OH ki tarah qataar mein aate hain, har jor ke H aur OH dashed dabbon mein. Peela teer 'Condensation reaction' H-X-Y-X-Y-OH + 3H2O tak le jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 26.3: Condensation polymerisation ki wazahat (kitab ki Figure 26.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Do qism ke monomers hain: H-X-H aur HO-Y-OH. Jahan X aur Y jurte hain wahan aik H aur aik OH mil kar H₂O ban kar nikal jate hain (dashed box). Chaar monomers jurne par teen jor bante hain, is liye 3H₂O nikalta hai.
a) Polyesters

Polyesters ki backbone (asal chain) mein ester links [—C(=O)—O—] hote hain. Aik diol (do -OH groups wala molecule) aur aik dicarboxylic acid (do -COOH groups wala molecule) monomers ke tor par mil kar polyester banate hain. Diol ka -OH acid ke -COOH se react karta hai aur paani ka aik molecule nikal jata hai, jaise neeche dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Monomers: HOCH2CH2OH (ethane-1,2-diol) aur HOOC-C6H4-COOH (benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid). Polymerisation: ...+ HOCH2CH2OH HOOC-C6H4-COOH HOCH2CH2OH HOOC-C6H4-COOH +..., diol ke OH ka H aur tezaab ka OH magenta rang mein. Teer se ...OCH2CH2OOC-C6H4-COOCH2CH2OOC-C6H4-CO-..., aur chaaron ester links ke neeche + H2O.
blocks.caption: Terylene/PET ki tayyari, ethane-1,2-diol aur benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid se polyester (kitab ke PDF safha 148 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Diol ke -OH ka H aur acid ke -COOH ka OH (magenta) mil kar H₂O bante hain. Jahan yeh nikalte hain wahan -CO-O- ester link banta hai. Chain ka dohrane wala hissa (repeat unit) -OCH₂CH₂O-CO-C₆H₄-CO- hai: aik diol aur aik acid.

Polyesters ki tensile strength (khinchne par na tootne ki taqat) zyada hai, is liye in se fibres (resha) bante hain. Polyester sasta hai aur is mein silwatein (creases) nahi parteen, is liye yeh cotton ki jagah use hota hai. Yeh plastic ke tor par bhi use hota hai; maslan PETE se mashroobat (beverages) aur khane ki packaging ki plastic botlein banti hain. Polyester ko cross links (chains ke darmiyan jor) ke tor par istemal kar ke sakht plastics bhi banaye jate hain, jaise glass fibre se mazboot kiya gaya cross-linked polyester.
b) Polyamides
Polyamides ki backbone mein amide links [—C(=O)—NH—] hote hain. Yeh kai mukhtalif starting materials se banaye ja sakte hain.
i) Diamine aur dicarboxylic acid se

Diamine (do -NH₂ groups wala molecule) aur dicarboxylic acid (do -COOH groups wala molecule) jur kar polyamide banate hain. Diamine ka -NH₂ acid ke -COOH se react karta hai aur paani ka molecule nikal jata hai.

blocks.alt: nH2N-CH2-NH2 (diamine) + nHOOC-CH2-COOH (dicarboxylic acid) se [-HN-CH2-NH-C(=O)-CH2-C(=O)-]n (polyamide) + 2nH2O; har C=O mein O, C ke oopar.
blocks.caption: Diamine aur dicarboxylic acid se polyamide (kitab ke PDF safha 149 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; paani 2nH2O likha gaya).

blocks.text: Misal: Nylon 6,6 hexamethylenediamine aur adipic acid se banta hai.
ii) Diamine aur dioyl chloride se

Diamine aur dioyl chloride (do -COCl groups wala molecule) monomers ke tor par jur kar polyamide banate hain. Dioyl chlorides dicarboxylic acids se zyada reactive hain. Diamine ka -NH₂ dioyl chloride ke -COCl se react karta hai aur hydrogen chloride (HCl) ka molecule nikal jata hai. Aam equation neeche hai:

blocks.caption: Diamine aur dioyl chloride se polyamide (kitab ke PDF safha 149 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; HCl 2nHCl likha gaya).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab in dono schemes mein + nH₂O aur + nHCl likhti hai. Lekin har repeat unit mein do amide links (jor) hain, aur har jor par aik chhota molecule nikalta hai. Is liye n diamine aur n diacid (ya dioyl chloride) se 2n H₂O (ya 2n HCl) nikalte hain; drawing mein sahi 2n likha hai. Amino acid wali scheme mein har unit mein aik hi jor hai, is liye wahan nH₂O sahi hai.

Amino acid aik hi monomer hai jis ke aik molecule mein -NH₂ (amino) group aur -COOH (carboxylic acid) group dono hote hain. Aik amino acid ka -NH₂ doosre amino acid ke -COOH se react karta hai, paani nikalta hai aur peptide bond banta hai. Peptide bond bhi amide linkage ki aik qism hai. Aam equation neeche hai:

blocks.caption: Amino acid se polyamide (polypeptide) (kitab ke PDF safha 149 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Proteins qudrati polyamides hain jo amino acids se bante hain; in ka zikr Biochemistry (Chapter 27) mein hoga.

Amide linkage acyl chlorides (bohat reactive organic compounds) aur amine ke darmiyan bhi banta hai, maslan ammonia, methanamine (CH₃-NH₂) ya dimethylamine, (CH₃)₂NH. Jab acyl chloride ammonia ya amine se react karta hai to hydrogen chloride (HCl) gas ka molecule nikal jata hai. Acyl chlorides kaafi reactive hain, is liye yeh reaction room temperature (kamre ke darja-e-hararat) par aasani se ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-Cl (acyl chloride) + R'-NH2 (amine) se R-C(=O)-NH-R' (amide) + HCl (hydrogen chloride).
blocks.caption: Acyl chloride aur amine se amide (kitab ke PDF safha 149 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab (CH₃)₂NH ko "N, N-dimethylamine" likhti hai. Is ka aam naam dimethylamine aur IUPAC naam N-methylmethanamine hai.

blocks.prompt: Diamine aur dioyl chloride ke reaction mein kaun sa chhota molecule nikalta hai, aur dioyl chloride kyun use kiya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen chloride (HCl) nikalta hai. Dioyl chlorides dicarboxylic acids se zyada reactive hain, is liye reaction aasani se hota hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Condensation: har naye bond par aik chhota molecule (H₂O, HCl, CH₃OH ya NH₃) nikalta hai; monomer mein kam az kam do reactive groups.
Polyesters (-CO-O-): diol + dicarboxylic acid, maslan Terylene/PET.
Polyamides (-CO-NH-): diamine + dicarboxylic acid ya dioyl chloride, ya amino acids (peptide bond).
Acyl chloride + ammonia/amine → amide + HCl, room temperature par.
